data.desc: OneConstruction Group is a structural steelwork contractor based in Hong Kong. Through its operating subsidiary, OneConstruction Engineering Projects Limited, ONEG specializes in the procurement and installation of structural steel across a diverse range of construction projects in Hong Kong, including residential and commercial developments as well as infrastructure works. While much of its work is commissioned by the public sector, ONEG also serves private clients, delivering customized steel solutions tailored to Hong Kong's construction needs.
